description: A bed is in front of you with a light pink pillow, a coiled white charging cable near the center, and a small pink rectangular device on the right side. The right hand reaches to the pink device and lifts it slightly while the left hand gathers the charging cable and brings the connector toward the device; the left hand briefly aligns the plug at the port, then pulls the cable back and leaves it coiled as the right hand slides the device to the right and releases it.
